run_habitat_viewer: run the habitat viewer for the apt_1 scene using the replica_cad dataset via mrp
create_conda_process: create an mrp process with a conda runtime that installs habitat-sim and runs the habitat viewer
setup_conda_environment: setup a conda environment with conda-forge and aihabitat channels and the habitat-sim dependency
download_replica_cad_dataset: download the replica_cad_dataset using the habitat_sim utils datasets_download command as a setup step
run_mrp_main: run the mrp main entrypoint to execute all defined processes from the msetup file
